description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing S&P 500 multiples data from the Multpl website, including asynchronous data extraction and validation.

classes.name: MultplSP500MultiplesQueryParams
classes.description: Extends SP500MultiplesQueryParams with validation for series_name, allowing multiple selections from URL_DICT.

classes.name: MultplSP500MultiplesData
classes.description: Extends SP500MultiplesData with alias mapping for 'date' and 'value'.

classes.name: MultplSP500MultiplesFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class implementing methods to transform query parameters, asynchronously extract data from URLs, and transform raw data into validated models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a MultplSP500MultiplesQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches, processes, and returns S&P 500 multiples data from multiple URLs based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data dictionaries into validated MultplSP500MultiplesData instances, sorted by date and name.
